sentences.text:
The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 251 of 2022, under
Sections 363, 366. 376 Ipc and 3/4 Pocso Act, police station - Kotwali Hathras, District - Hathras,
with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant/accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Applicant is not named in the FIR, which was lodged against one Gaurav.

In statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., victim-girl has stated that she herself has left her home and went to Hathras and there applicant met her and from there they have gone to Muktasar Sahib (Punjab) and they stayed together there as husband and wife.

She has stated that Aman Ali @ Hasan Muhammad vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108231360/
1 she was having love affair with applicant.

sentences.text: In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., victim-girl has stated that due to some fight with her father, she has gone to Mathura and from there she alone went to Punjab, where applicant met her and thereafter they lived as husband and wife at Muktasar Sahib (Punjab).
She has stated that she has gone with the applicant at her own free will and no one has kidnapped her and nothing was done forcefully with her.
As per School record, age of the victim-girl has been mentioned about 17-years, but as per ossification test, her age has been shown 18-19 years and thus she is major girl.

4. Referring to the facts of the matter, it is submitted that there is no allegation of kidnapping of victim-girl against applicant and that in view of age and statement of victim, no case is made out against him.

Lastly, it has been submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 01.11.2022,
having no criminal history, and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

5. Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the informant, have opposed the prayer of bail and argued that as per School record, the date of birth of the victim girl is 01.01.2005 and thus at the time of alleged incident she was aged about 17 years.

However, it has not been disputed that in her statement under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., victim girl has stated that she has left home at her own free will and nothing was done forcefully with her.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

7. Let the applicant Aman Ali @ Hasan Mushmmad involved in aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below subject to following conditions:
(i). The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii).The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii).The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
(iv) The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

(v). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
